Thomas De Quincey, Suspiria de Profundis.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-de-quincey/suspiria-de-profundis

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas De Quincey (annotator, author), died 1859.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'Suspiria de Profundis was published between 1845 and 1891 by Thomas De Quincey.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published before 1931 (SE colophon: 'Suspiria de Profundis was published between 1845 and 1891 by Thomas De Quincey.'), so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin: does not matter, because every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die died in 1859.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
